title: Model comparison and reproducible regression checks
text: age-fit reproduces chain ladder. Partial forecasting fills requested future calendar diagonals.
code: data("AutoBI", package = "ChainLadder") triangle <- ChainLadder::incr2cum(AutoBI$AutoBIPaid) prepared <- AggregateDataPP(triangle) model_ids <- c("a", "ac", "ap", "apc") fits <- setNames(lapply(model_ids, function(id) {   clmplus(prepared, hazard.model = id, verbose = FALSE) }), model_ids) predictions <- lapply(fits, predict) mack <- ChainLadder::MackChainLadder(triangle) age_prediction <- predictions[["a"]] stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(   unname(age_prediction$full_triangle),   unname(mack$FullTriangle),   tolerance = 1e-10 ))) data.frame(   accident_period = seq_along(age_prediction$reserve) - 1L,   reserve = unname(age_prediction$reserve),   ultimate = unname(age_prediction$ultimate_cost) ) #>   accident_period   reserve  ultimate #> 1               0      0.00  63918.00 #> 2               1  11995.02  74756.02 #> 3               2  28848.23  89937.23 #> 4               3  47752.62  99797.62 #> 5               4  67734.68 107290.68 #> 6               5  74742.25  96776.25 #> 7               6  97541.29 109482.29 #> 8               7 102444.81 105245.81 sum(age_prediction$reserve) #> [1] 431058.9 one_year <- predict(fits[["apc"]], forecasting_horizon = 1) dim(one_year$full_triangle) #> [1] 8 8 dim(one_year$apc_output$lower_triangle_apc) #> [1] 8 1 plot(fits[["apc"]]) plot(predictions[["apc"]])

title: Pre-process Run-Off Triangles — AggregateDataPP
text: cumulative.payments.triangle square numeric matrix least two rows. Rows accident periods, columns development periods, observed upper-triangle cells satisfy `row + column <= J + 1`.
